VENDOR SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Vendor Services Agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of the
Effective Date set forth below, between Acme Fulfillment Solutions LLC
("Vendor") and Beta Retail Client Inc. ("Client").

Effective date: January 15, 2026

Section 1. Term and Payment.
Payment terms are net 30 days from the date of invoice. Client shall remit
payment in full within thirty (30) days of receipt of a valid invoice from
Vendor.

Section 2. Termination.
Either party may terminate this Agreement by providing 60 days written
notice to the other party. Termination shall not relieve either party of
obligations accrued prior to the termination date.

Section 3. Contract Value.
The total contract value is $120,000.00 for the initial twelve-month term.

Section 4. Indemnification.
Vendor agrees to indemnify and hold harmless Client from third-party claims
arising out of Vendor's gross negligence, provided that Vendor's aggregate
indemnification liability under this Section shall not exceed $50,000.00.

Section 5. Governing Law.
This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Delaware,
without regard to its conflict of laws principles.
